article_content: Eighteen-year-old Oksana Makar succumbed to injuries from a brutal sexual assault, torture, and arson committed by three men in Ukraine. The attackers - Maxim Prisyjnikov (son of a regional official), Artyom Pogosyan (prosecutor's son), and Yevgeniy Krasnoshek - subjected her to repeated rape and strangulation before abandoning her in a burning cloth wrap at a construction site. The 55% full-thickness burns necessitated amputations of one arm and both legs. Despite medical teams' efforts, Makar died from lung damage complications. A video recorded by her mother revealed her fragmented account of the March 9 attack, which spurred national outrage after two suspects were initially freed due to 'insufficient evidence.' Protests led by Femen activists highlighted systemic corruption in Ukraine's justice system, prompting authorities to re-arrest the men and charge them with attempted murder. However, investigations faced criticism for delayed victim testimony collection. Controversy arose regarding Makar's mother, who faced accusations of exploiting donations and monetizing media coverage. Medical staff noted Makar's valiant survival attempts until her final hours, with her last statement expressing resolve to endure despite extreme suffering.

article_content: Think of a swimsuit as your strategic dare-to-bare ally: Find one in a flattering color and cut, and it can give you the confidence you’ll want when it’s time to drop the towel. Swimsuit shopping can be challenging, but with effort, you’ll find a suit that downplays areas you’re less confident about and highlights what you love. To maximize a small bust, underwires, boning, and subtle padding add shape and fullness. Ensure padding remains discreet even when wet. Ruffles and shirring can distract from areas needing camouflage. Stylist Jeanne Yang suggests bold patterns or embellishments to draw focus away from a petite chest. For larger busts, avoid tops that are too tight to prevent spillage. Note suits often run two sizes smaller than clothing. Underwire or built-in bras offer support. Opt for sturdy straps over keyholes or string bikinis. Combat belly bulge with plunging halter tops or midsection details. One-pieces with tummy-control panels (like Miraclesuit’s high-spandex designs) or tankinis for two-pieces are recommended. Ensure waistbands prevent spillover. High-leg cuts slim thighs, while avoiding boy shorts and rear-focused prints keeps lower halves balanced. Use color blocks or light tones at the chest to divert attention from broader hips.

article_content: El Corpus, Honduras (CNN) — Three of 11 miners trapped in a Honduran gold mine since Wednesday were rescued Friday morning. Rescuers freed the trio nearly two days after a landslide blocked their exit path. Live footage aired by Honduran network Televicentro showed ambulances transporting the survivors. Over 100 Red Cross volunteers, firefighters, and local workers have worked tirelessly to reach the miners since the tunnel was blocked late Wednesday, according to El Corpus Mayor Luis Rueda. Details about the condition of the rescued miners and the eight still trapped remain unavailable. The three freed miners had maintained communication with rescue teams, enabling early provision of water supplies. Prior to the rescue, Mayor Rueda reported rescue efforts were advancing 'slowly and with difficulty' due to landslide risks. Fire department official Oscar Triminio stated rescuers avoided heavy machinery to prevent destabilizing the mine further. Arrests made in Turkey following fatal mine fire. article_content: Arsenal solidified their European credentials with a resolute 1-0 victory over Champions League finalists Borussia Dortmund. Aaron Ramsey's second-half header - his 11th goal in 16 matches this season - proved decisive as the Gunners overcame a dominant but wasteful Dortmund performance. Despite controlling possession, the hosts failed to convert chances, with Henrikh Mkhitaryan particularly guilty of missing clear opportunities. Manager Arsene Wenger praised his team's composure, noting Ramsey's remarkable turnaround from scoring just five times in two years to becoming a match-winning force. Elsewhere, Barcelona secured their 10th straight knockout-phase qualification as Lionel Messi ended his goal drought with a double. Chelsea bounced back from Premier League disappointment with a 3-0 win over Schalke, while Atletico Madrid clinched progression through a 4-0 thrashing of Austria Vienna. Group standings now see Arsenal and Napoli tied on nine points, with Dortmund facing an uphill battle after losing ground to their Italian rivals.

article_content: AC Milan forward Mario Balotelli has resolved to move beyond his 'Mad Mario' reputation and prove himself as the world's top striker before Italy's World Cup opener against England in Manaus. The 23-year-old, whose career has included off-field headlines during his Manchester City days, now focuses on on-pitch excellence. 'The press loves writing about Mario - regardless of truth,' he explained. 'I reject that label. My aim is to be acknowledged as football's leading marksman.' Targeting Italy's fifth World Cup triumph, Balotelli emphasized: 'Legendary campaigns begin with matches like this. I want to be remembered as a World Cup winner whose legacy comes purely from performance.'

article_content: The United Kingdom will send roughly 75 military advisors to Ukraine to assist with tactical intelligence sharing and defensive infantry training. Prime Minister David Cameron warned that tolerating Vladimir Putin's territorial ambitions risks replicating historical appeasement failures, stressing that unchecked Russian expansion could destabilize Moldova or Baltic nations. While avoiding lethal arms, the UK will provide protective gear and logistical support alongside medical and intelligence training programs. Cameron reaffirmed NATO commitments, stating collective defense obligations remain absolute. Domestic critics condemned the government's secrecy regarding sanctioned Russian nationals with UK ties, citing unresolved concerns about criminal networks operating in Britain. Advocates urged greater transparency akin to the US Magnitsky Act, which targets corrupt elites linked to human rights violations, contrasting with current policies prioritizing diplomatic discretion.

article_content: Calais authorities have intensified criticism of UK immigration policies they claim fuel illegal migration to northern France. Deputy Mayor Philippe Mignonet, overseeing anti-smuggling operations, accused Britain of 'grotesque hypocrisy' for opposing immigration while permitting unregulated labor markets employing an estimated 2 million undocumented workers. The port city currently hosts 400 migrants in makeshift shelters, with daily arrivals attempting Channel crossings via ferries or dangerous swims. Officials warn conditions mirror pre-Sangatte crisis levels prior to its 2002 closure. Recent tragedies include an Eritrean man's drowning during a midnight harbor swim and a woman found dead on Calais beaches after a suspected 2009 Channel swim attempt. Local leaders accuse anarchist groups like No Borders of enabling migrant squatting, while France's Socialist government recently approved new state-managed migrant centers near the port.
